docs.title: Mixer User Guide
docs.text:
Welcome to the Mixer App!

Welcome to the user guide for your Mixer machine. This documentation will help you set up and use your machine to create perfect mixes every time.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
• Home Screen Dashboard - Overview of the central control panel.
  • Setting Up Your Mixer - A step-by-step guide on how to prepare your machine for the first time.
  • Pots Management - How to manage ingredients and monitor pot status.
  • Recipes and Dispensing - How to select and make your favorite mixes.

docs.title: Support
docs.text: For more help, please contact our support team or visit our website.

docs.title: User Guide: Home Screen Dashboard
docs.text: The Home screen provides an overview of the machine status, activity, and maintenance needs.

docs.title: 1. Usage Statistics
docs.text:
Summarizes machine performance and maintenance needs.

  • Calibration Needed: Shows pots requiring calibration.
  • Today's Orders: Shows recipes successfully produced today.
  • This Week (Failed): Shows failed production attempts this week.
  • This Week (Success): Shows successful productions this week.

docs.title: 2. Recent Recipes & Activity
docs.text:
Lists recent production records.

  • Shows the recipe, target volume, weight error, order ID, status, and start time.
  • Tap a recipe to open its details.

docs.title: 3. Low/Empty Pots Management
docs.text:
Shows low or empty ingredient pots.

  • Low ingredients: Lists pots below 1500 ml or empty.
  • Refilling: Tap an ingredient to open the refill interface.

Tip: Check the Hardware Status panel first when a red hardware warning appears.

docs.title: Setting Up Your Mixer
docs.text: This guide will help you through the first-time setup of your Mixer machine. The setup wizard is designed to prepare the machine for use, ensuring everything is calibrated and ready to go.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
The setup process is a simple, step-by-step guide. When you begin, the machine will reset to its factory state: - Any current user will be signed out. - Previous settings will be cleared. - All ingredient containers will be reset. - The recipe list will be refreshed.

The guide consists of several easy steps.

docs.title: 1. Connect and Identify
docs.text:
The first step is to connect your machine to the internet and identify it.

Scan the QR code on the back or side of your machine.

  • Wi-Fi Connection: Make sure your machine is connected to a reliable Wi-Fi network.
  • Scanning: Use the app to scan the QR code on your machine. This helps the app recognize your specific device.
  • Registration: The app will automatically register your machine with our service.
  • Checking Components: The machine will perform a quick check of its internal parts, like the scanner and pumps.
  • Loading Data: Your machine will download the latest configuration and available ingredients.

docs.title: 2. Scale Calibration
docs.text:
Next, you will be guided through making sure the built-in scale is accurate.

The scale calibration screen.

  • Accuracy Check: This step ensures that the scale measures ingredients correctly.
  • Zeroing: You'll be asked to make sure the scale reads zero when empty.
  • Weight Check: You might be asked to place a known weight to confirm accuracy.
  • Next Step: Once the scale is accurate, you can move to the next part.

docs.title: 3. Pump Calibration
docs.text:
This step ensures that the machine dispenses the exact amount of each ingredient.

Testing each pump for accuracy.

  • Dispensing Accuracy: Each pump is tested to make sure it delivers the right amount of liquid.
  • Validation: You will confirm that each ingredient container is ready and calibrated.
  • Ready to Use: Once confirmed, your machine is officially set up and ready to use! You will be taken to your main Dashboard.

docs.title: Finishing Setup
docs.text:
Once you finish the pump calibration:

Your machine's main dashboard.

  1. Your machine is marked as "Ready."
  2. You will be taken to your Dashboard, where you can start making recipes!

docs.title: Machine Testing Checklist
docs.text: Complete this checklist before sending the machine to the store.

docs.title: Pots
docs.text:
• Bind an ingredient to a pot and confirm that the ingredient is shown.
  • Open the pot menu, select Unbind Pot, and confirm that the ingredient is removed.
  • Calibrate each pot and confirm that the calibration is complete.

docs.title: Machine Components
docs.text:
• Test the screen and confirm that it responds to touch.
  • Test the network connection.
  • Test the scale and confirm that it reads weight correctly.
  • Test the scanner.
  • Test the sound.
  • Test the heater, if installed.
  • Run the motors and confirm stable operation.

docs.title: Recipes and Accuracy
docs.text:
• Dispense multiple recipes and confirm that each recipe completes successfully.
  • Check the dispensed amount for each recipe against its required specification and confirm the accuracy.

docs.title: Refill
docs.text:
• Refill a pot and confirm that the refill process completes successfully.
  • Confirm that the machine is ready before sending it to the store.

docs.title: Customizations
docs.text:
Customizations are reusable options that can be attached to recipes, such as Size, Sugar level or Temperature. Each customization has a code, a name and a list of values. This page explains how to manage them.

To attach a customization to a specific recipe, see Recipe Customization.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
The Customizations screen lists each customization's code, name, values and status.

Screenshot placeholder: the customizations list.

docs.title: Create a customization
docs.text:
1. Click New.
  2. Enter the code, name and the list of values.
  3. Save.

docs.title: Edit a customization
docs.text:
1. Click the edit icon on the row.
  2. Update the fields and values.
  3. Save.

docs.title: Enable or disable a customization
docs.text: Use the status toggle in the row.

docs.title: Delete a customization
docs.text:
1. Click the delete icon on the row.
  2. Confirm in the dialog.

docs.title: Ingredients
docs.text:
Ingredients (materials) are the raw items used by recipes. This page explains how to create and manage them, and how to import them from Excel.

To choose which ingredients a specific recipe uses, see Recipe Ingredients.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
The Ingredients screen lists your ingredients and lets you search, create, edit and delete them.

Screenshot placeholder: the ingredients list.

  • Search – type a keyword in the search box to filter ingredients.

docs.title: Create an ingredient
docs.text:
1. Click New.
  2. Fill in the ingredient details.
  3. Save.

docs.title: Edit an ingredient
docs.text:
1. Click the edit icon on the row.
  2. Update the fields.
  3. Save.

docs.title: Enable or disable an ingredient
docs.text: Use the status toggle in the row.

docs.title: Delete an ingredient
docs.text:
• Single – click the delete icon on the row and confirm.
  • Batch – select ingredients with the checkboxes, then click Delete in the toolbar and confirm.

docs.title: Importing Ingredients from Excel
docs.text:
1. Click Upload.
  2. Select the Excel file.
  3. The ingredients from the file are imported into the list.

Screenshot placeholder: importing ingredients from an Excel file.

docs.title: Machines
docs.text:
The Machines screen lists the machines available to you and lets you bind them to stores, set their password, and review each machine's configuration and data.

Machines are registered during the factory setup process. From the manager dashboard you configure and monitor machines; you do not create or delete them here.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
The machine list shows each machine's UUID, PLC UUID, model, hardware version, remark, the store it is bound to, and its creation date.

Screenshot placeholder: the machines list.

docs.title: Binding a Machine to a Store
docs.text:
• If the machine is not bound, click Bind to Store, choose the store and confirm.
  • If the machine is already bound, its store name is shown as a button; click it to change the store.

docs.title: Unbinding a Machine
docs.text:
1. Click the unlink icon next to the bound store.
  2. Confirm in the dialog. The machine is detached from the store.

docs.title: Changing the Machine Password
docs.text:
1. Click the password icon in the machine row.
  2. Enter and confirm the new password.
  3. Save.

docs.title: Channels
docs.text:
Click Channels to open the machine's channel configuration, which shows the machine's pots and the ingredients bound to them.

Screenshot placeholder: the machine channels dialog.

docs.title: Machine Details
docs.text:
Click a machine row to open its details page, which contains:

  • Basic Info – the machine's main information.
  • Channels – the pots and their bound ingredients.
  • Production Records – the drinks produced by this machine, with statistics. See Production Records and Statistics.
  • Cleaning – the machine's cleaning data.
  • Activities – the machine's activity log.

Screenshot placeholder: the machine details page.

docs.title: Manager Documentation
docs.text: The Manager area of the Mixer web dashboard is where you manage products (recipes, ingredients and customizations), organize stores and machines, monitor production, and manage user accounts.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
The manager menu is grouped into two sections:

Product Managing

  • Recipes – create and manage recipes, import/export from Excel, and distribute them to stores.
  • Ingredients – manage the raw materials used in recipes.
  • Customizations – manage reusable options (for example sugar level or size) that can be attached to recipes.
  • Production Records – review the drinks produced across your machines.

Settings

  • Stores – organize stores into groups and assign recipes to them.
  • Machines – bind machines to stores, set machine passwords and review machine data.
  • Users – manage the accounts that can sign in to the dashboard.

docs.title: Typical Workflow
docs.text:
A common end‑to‑end flow for a manager is:

  1. Create the ingredients and customizations you need.
  2. Create your recipes and configure their ingredients, customizations and combinations.
  3. Distribute the recipes to the relevant stores or store groups.
  4. Organize your stores and bind machines to them.
  5. Monitor production records and statistics.

Screenshot placeholder: the manager dashboard with the sidebar menu.

docs.title: Production Records
docs.text: The Production Records screen lists the drinks produced across your machines, so you can review what was made and investigate problems.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Each record shows the recipe that was produced, the order information, and the outcome. Click a recipe name to quickly filter the list by that recipe.

Screenshot placeholder: the production records list.

docs.title: Filtering Records
docs.text:
Use the filters at the top of the list to narrow the records:

  • Keyword – search records by recipe.
  • Order – filter by whether the record has an order.
  • Status – filter by the record's status.
  • Error – filter records that ended with an error.
  • Date range – limit the records to a start and end date.

Screenshot placeholder: the filter popovers for order, status, error and date range.

docs.title: Material Records
docs.text:
Open a record's material records to see the ingredients that were dispensed for that production, including the amounts.

Screenshot placeholder: the material records dialog for a production record.

docs.title: Records for a Single Machine
docs.text: The production records for one machine are also available on the machine's details page. See Machines. For usage charts and totals, see Statistics.

docs.title: Recipe Combinations
docs.text: Combinations define the exact ingredient amounts a recipe uses for each combination of its customization values. This page is part of the recipe configuration.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
When a recipe has customizations (for example Size: Small / Large and Sugar: 50% / 100%), the system generates one row for every possible combination of the selected values. For each combination you enter how much of each ingredient the recipe uses.

Screenshot placeholder: the combinations table with a column per ingredient and a row per customization combination.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
Before configuring combinations, make sure the recipe already has:

  • its ingredients selected, and
  • its customizations selected.

docs.title: Setting Ingredient Amounts
docs.text:
1. Open the recipe details and go to the Combinations section.
  2. For each combination row, enter the amount for each ingredient column.
  3. Use the per‑combination Others option to set additional values for that combination when needed.
  4. Save your changes.

The overall totals are calculated from the amounts you enter, so you can verify each combination at a glance.

docs.title: Recipe Customization
docs.text:
A recipe can offer customization options such as size or sugar level. This page explains how to attach customizations to a recipe. It is part of the recipe configuration.

Customizations are created and managed on the Customizations screen. Here you only choose which existing customization values apply to the recipe.

docs.title: Viewing the Recipe Customizations
docs.text:
Open a recipe's details page. The Customizations section lists all customizations grouped by name, showing which values are selected for this recipe.

Screenshot placeholder: the recipe customizations section.

docs.title: Editing the Recipe Customizations
docs.text:
1. Click the edit icon in the Customizations section.
  2. Check or uncheck the customization values that should apply to the recipe. Use Select all to toggle every value.
  3. Click Save.

The selected customization values determine the combinations you configure in Recipe Combinations.

docs.title: Recipe Ingredients
docs.text:
Every recipe uses a set of ingredients (materials). This page explains how to choose which ingredients a recipe uses. It is part of the recipe configuration.

Ingredients themselves are created and managed on the Ingredients screen. Here you only select which existing ingredients the recipe uses.

docs.title: Viewing the Recipe Ingredients
docs.text:
Open a recipe's details page. The Materials section lists the ingredients used by the recipe with their code, name, expiration and group.

Screenshot placeholder: the recipe ingredients (materials) section.

docs.title: Editing the Recipe Ingredients
docs.text:
1. Click the edit icon in the Materials section.
  2. Use the ingredient selector to add or remove ingredients. You can search for an ingredient by name.
  3. Click Save.

After changing the ingredients you can set their amounts per option in Recipe Combinations.

docs.title: Recipes
docs.text: The Recipes screen is where you create and manage the recipes that machines can produce. From here you can also import and export recipes as Excel files and distribute them to stores.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
The recipe list shows each recipe's image, code, name, external code, category, creation date, status and remark.

Screenshot placeholder: the recipes list.

  • Search – type a keyword in the search box to filter recipes.
  • Category – use the category selector to filter by category.

docs.title: Create a recipe
docs.text:
1. Click New.
  2. Fill in the basic information.
  3. Save.

After creating a recipe you can configure its ingredients, customizations and combinations.

docs.title: Edit a recipe
docs.text:
1. Click the edit icon on the recipe row.
  2. Update the basic information.
  3. Save.

docs.title: Copy a recipe
docs.text: Click the copy icon on the recipe row to create a new recipe pre‑filled from the selected one.

docs.title: Enable or disable a recipe
docs.text: Use the status toggle in the recipe row.

docs.title: Delete a recipe
docs.text:
• Single – click the delete icon on the recipe row and confirm.
  • Batch – select recipes with the checkboxes, then click Delete in the toolbar and confirm.

docs.title: Categories and Recipe Groups
docs.text:
• Use the category selector to filter the list by category.
  • Delete a category with the delete icon next to it in the selector.
  • Choose New at the bottom of the selector to create a recipe group.

docs.title: Importing Recipes from Excel
docs.text:
1. Click Upload Excel.
  2. Select the Excel file. A preview of the recipes to be imported is shown.
  3. Confirm the import.

Screenshot placeholder: the Excel import preview dialog.

docs.title: Exporting Recipes to Excel
docs.text:
1. Select one or more recipes with the checkboxes.
  2. Click Download in the toolbar. The selected recipes are exported as an Excel file.

docs.title: Distributing Recipes to Stores
docs.text:
1. Select one or more recipes with the checkboxes.
  2. Click Distribute in the toolbar.
  3. In the dialog, choose whether to distribute to a single Store or to a Store Group.
  4. Select the target store or group and confirm.

Screenshot placeholder: the distribute dialog with the Store and Store Group tabs.

You can also manage a store's recipes from the Stores screen.

docs.title: Recipe Configuration
docs.text:
Click a recipe row to open its details page, where you configure:

  • Basic Info – the recipe's main information.
  • Customizations – the options attached to the recipe.
  • Ingredients – the materials used by the recipe.
  • Combinations – the ingredient amounts for each customization combination.
  • History – the change history of the recipe.

docs.title: Statistics
docs.text: Statistics turn a machine's production records into charts and totals so you can see how much has been produced over a period of time.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Statistics are available per machine, from the Production Records section of the machine's details page. Open a machine (see Machines) and open its statistics view.

Screenshot placeholder: the machine statistics view with charts.

docs.title: Choosing a Time Range
docs.text:
Statistics default to today. Use the range controls to change the period:

  • Today
  • Yesterday
  • Last 7 days
  • Custom – pick a start and end date and apply.

docs.title: Reading the Charts
docs.text:
The statistics view summarizes production for the selected range, including production counts and error totals. Use the exclude cancelled toggle to leave cancelled or stopped productions out of the error totals.

For the underlying, row‑by‑row data, see Production Records.

docs.title: Stores
docs.text: Stores represent the physical locations that run your machines. This page explains how to organize stores into groups, create and edit stores, link machines, and manage the recipes assigned to each store.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
The Stores screen has two areas:

  • Store Groups (left) – a tree of groups used to organize your stores.
  • Stores (right) – the list of stores, optionally filtered by the selected group.

Screenshot placeholder: the stores screen with the group tree on the left and the store list on the right.

docs.title: Store Groups
docs.text:
Use the group tree on the left to filter and organize stores.

  • Select All to list every store, or select a group to list only its stores.
  • Use the expand / collapse button to show or hide the group panel.
  • Click the settings (gear) icon to open the Store Groups manager, where you create, rename and remove groups.

docs.title: Create a store
docs.text:
1. (Optional) Select a group on the left so the new store is created under it.
  2. Click New.
  3. Fill in the store details (code, name, type, group, external code, tags, users).
  4. Save.

docs.title: Edit a store
docs.text:
1. Click the edit icon on the store row.
  2. Update the fields.
  3. Save.

docs.title: Enable or disable a store
docs.text: Use the status toggle in the store row to activate or deactivate a store.

docs.title: Delete a store
docs.text:
1. Click the delete icon on the store row.
  2. Confirm in the dialog.

docs.title: Linking Machines to a Store
docs.text:
1. Click the machines icon on the store row to open the Store Machines dialog.
  2. Add or remove the machines that belong to this store.

You can also bind a machine to a store from the Machines screen.

docs.title: Store Recipes
docs.text:
Each store has its own set of assigned recipes.

  • Click the recipes icon on a store row (or on a group in the tree) to open the Store Recipes dialog and review or adjust the assigned recipes.
  • Click the sync recipes icon to synchronize the store's recipes.

docs.title: Import recipes into a group
docs.text:
1. Select a group in the tree.
  2. Click Import Recipes.
  3. Choose the recipes to import into the group's stores.

For distributing recipes from the recipe list, see Distributing Recipes to Stores.

docs.title: Store Details
docs.text:
Click a store row to open its details page, which shows:

  • Basic Info – the store's main information.
  • Machines – the machines linked to the store.
  • Recipes – the recipes assigned to the store.

Screenshot placeholder: the store details page with basic info, machines and recipes.

docs.title: Cleaning Module Documentation
docs.text: This document provides an overview and user guide for the Cleaning Module of the Mixer application. The cleaning module ensures that the beverage dispensing pipes and pots are maintained in a hygienic state.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: The Cleaning Module allows users to perform routine and deep cleaning of the machine's dispensing channels (pots). It tracks the last cleaning time for each pot and provides a guided multi-step deep cleaning process.

docs.title: 1. Cleaning Status Dashboard
docs.text: The main cleaning screen displays all pots and their current cleaning status: - Pot Information: Displays pot number and the name of the assigned ingredient. - Last Cleaned Timestamp: Shows the exact date and time the pot was last cleaned. - Status Indicators: - Green: Cleaned within the last 24 hours. - Orange/Warning: Not cleaned for more than 24 hours. - Red/Danger: Never cleaned or needs immediate attention.

docs.title: 2. Selection and Batch Cleaning
docs.text: Users can select individual pots or use the "Select All" feature to perform cleaning on multiple channels simultaneously.

docs.title: 3. Deep Cleaning Process
docs.text: Deep cleaning is a thorough sanitation process consisting of three main stages:

docs.title: Stage 1: Empty the Pipes (Rinse)
docs.text:
• Purpose: Uses warm water to rinse out any residual liquid from the pipes.
  • Adjustable Parameter: Flush Time (0 to 20 seconds).
  • Instruction: Add warm water into the pots before starting.

docs.title: Stage 2: Disinfection (Soak)
docs.text:
• Purpose: Uses disinfectant to soak the inner walls of the pipes to ensure thorough sanitation.
  • Adjustable Parameters:
  • Flush Time: Duration for initial disinfectant flow.
  • Soak Time: Duration the disinfectant remains in the pipes (up to 5 minutes).
  • Cycles: This step can be repeated multiple times for better results.

docs.title: Stage 3: Final Rinse
docs.text:
• Purpose: Uses fresh drinking water to flush out any remaining disinfectant from the pipes.
  • Adjustable Parameter: Flush Time.

docs.title: How to start a Deep Clean
docs.text:
1. Navigate to the Cleaning tab from the main navigation.
  2. Select Pots: Tap on the pots you wish to clean. You can also use "Select All".
  3. Tap Start Cleaning.
  4. Step 0 (Empty Pipes):
  5. Fill the selected pots with warm water.
  6. Adjust the flush time if necessary.
  7. Tap Start.
  8. Wait for the countdown to finish.
  9. Step 1 (Deep Clean/Disinfection):
  10. Fill the selected pots with disinfectant solution.
  11. Adjust both Flush and Soak times.
  12. Tap Start [Cycle X].
  13. After a cycle finishes, you can tap Start [Cycle X+1] to repeat or Done to move to the final stage.
  14. Step 2 (Final Rinse):
  15. Fill the pots with fresh drinking water.
  16. Adjust the flush time.
  17. Tap Start.
  18. Completion: Once all steps are finished, the system will update the "Last Cleaned" timestamp for all selected pots.

docs.title: Safety & Maintenance Tips
docs.text:
• It is recommended to perform cleaning at least once every 24 hours to maintain beverage quality and hygiene.
  • Always ensure you have the appropriate cleaning agents (warm water, disinfectant, fresh water) ready for each step.
  • Do not interrupt the cleaning process unless necessary. If paused, remember to resume to ensure the cycle completes.

docs.title: Cleaning
docs.text:
1. Remove the scale handle and place a large container under the dispenser.
  2. Disconnect the pipes from the containers and place them in a large container of hot water.
  3. Open the Pots screen.
  4. Tap Select in the footer.
  5. Select the pots you want to clean. Use the top tab navigator to identify pots that have not been cleaned and need cleaning.
  6. Tap Clean.
  7. In the Empty Pipe step, choose a duration or use the default, then tap Start.
  8. Wait for the Empty Pipe step to finish.
  9. Make sure the container under the dispenser is empty. Replace the hot water in the container holding the pipes with hot water and the required cleaning fluids.
  10. Choose the dispense and soak durations, then tap Start.
  11. After the Soak step finishes, repeat it one more time or finish the cleaning process. Perform this step once each morning for daily cleaning, or repeat it multiple times for a weekly deep clean.
  12. In the final Empty Pipe step, remove the container under the dispenser and replace the water in the hot-water container with hot water.
  13. Choose the duration and tap Start.
  14. Wait for the cleaning process to finish.

docs.title: Using a QR Code
docs.text:
1. Place a cup under the dispenser.
  2. Scan the QR code containing recipe and its specifications.
  3. Wait for the dispensing process to finish automatically.
  4. Check the completion summary.

docs.title: Using the Recipe Page
docs.text:
1. Open Recipes.
  2. Select a recipe.
  3. Select the specifications.
  4. Place a cup under the dispenser.
  5. Tap Dispense.
  6. Wait for the dispensing process to finish.
  7. Check the completion summary.

docs.title: Filling and Initiating Containers
docs.text:
1. Refill the pot with the required fluid.
  2. Place a large cup under the dispenser.
  3. Open the Pots screen.
  4. Tap the Menu icon (three vertical dots) on the pot.

  5. Select Refill.

  6. Tap Top Up.

  7. Wait for the brief initialization to finish, if it starts.

docs.title: Refilling Multiple Pots
docs.text:
1. Refill the pots with the required fluids.
  2. Place a large cup under the dispenser.
  3. Open the Pots screen.
  4. Tap Select in the footer.

  5. Select the pots you refilled.

  6. Tap Refill.

  7. Wait for the pots to initiate one by one.

  8. Confirm the process.

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text: Follow these steps to prepare the pots and dispense a recipe.

docs.title: Before You Begin
docs.text: 1. Make sure the machine is connected to the network and the empty scale shows 0.

docs.title: Bind an Ingredient
docs.text:
1. Open the Pots screen.
  2. Tap a pot with no ingredient assigned.
  3. Select an ingredient from the available materials list.
  4. Confirm that the ingredient name appears on the pot.

docs.title: Fill and Initiate a Pot
docs.text:
1. Tap the Menu icon (three vertical dots) on the pot.
  2. Select Refill.
  3. Adjust the slider to the new total volume.
  4. Tap Top Up.
  5. Wait for the brief initialization to finish, if it starts.

docs.title: Dispensing by Recipe
docs.text:
1. Open Recipes.
  2. Select a recipe.
  3. Select the specifications.
  4. Check that the ingredients are available and the dispensers are calibrated.
  5. Place a cup under the dispenser.
  6. Tap Dispense.
  7. Wait for the dispensing process to finish.
  8. Check the completion summary.

docs.title: Manual Dispensing
docs.text:
You can manually dispense a specific amount of an ingredient.

  1. Open the Pots screen.
  2. Tap the pot you want to dispense. The pot details open in the sidebar.
  3. Select or enter the desired amount in grams (g).
  4. Place a cup under the dispenser.
  5. Tap Dispense.
  6. Monitor the real-time dispensing weight and the final accuracy summary.
  7. Tap Stop if you need to interrupt the process.

docs.title: Pots Management Documentation
docs.text: The Pots Management feature allows you to monitor and manage the ingredients stored in the machine's individual containers (pots). Each pot is assigned a number and can be linked to a specific ingredient, heated, and manually dispensed.

docs.title: 📋 Overview of Pots
docs.text: The Pots screen displays all available containers. Each pot card shows: - Pot Number: The unique identifier for the container. - Ingredient Name: The name of the linked ingredient (if assigned). - Fill Level: The current volume in milliliters (ml). - Temperature: Current and target temperature (if heating is active). - Status Badges: Indicators for calibration status (e.g., "Uncalibrated", "Stale") or expiration.

docs.title: 🔗 Binding and Unbinding Ingredients
docs.text: To use a pot, it must be "bound" to an ingredient from the system's material list.

docs.title: Binding a Pot
docs.text:
1. Tap an empty pot (or a pot with no ingredient assigned).
  2. A list of available materials/ingredients will appear.
  3. Select the ingredient you wish to link to this pot.
  4. The pot will now display the ingredient name and default expiration settings.

docs.title: Unbinding a Pot
docs.text:
1. Tap the Menu icon (three vertical dots) on a pot card.
  2. Select Unbind Pot.
  3. Confirm the action. This will clear the ingredient assignment and reset the fill level.

docs.title: 🌡️ Temperature Control
docs.text:
Pots will not heat up unless the temperature is manually set.

If a pot is equipped with a heater, you can control its temperature.

  1. Tap the Temperature icon on the pot card (or access it via the Pot Menu).
  2. Use the slider to set the desired temperature (typically between 10°C and 40°C).
  3. Tap Set to start heating.
  4. You can monitor the "Current Temperature" in real-time.
  5. Tap Stop at any time to turn off the heater.

docs.title: 💧 Refilling and Depleting Pots
docs.text: The slider shows the current fill level in milliliters (ml). Keep track of the ingredient levels to ensure the machine can complete recipes.

docs.title: Refilling (Top Up)
docs.text:
1. Tap the Menu icon and select Refill (or tap the pot if the fill level is critically low).
  2. Adjust the slider to reflect the new total volume in the pot.
  3. Tap Top Up to save the changes. The machine may perform a brief initialization.

docs.title: Depleting (Clear)
docs.text:
1. Tap the Menu icon and select Clear.
  2. This will reset the pot's current fill level to 0ml, indicating it is empty.

docs.title: ⚖️ Calibration and Maintenance
docs.text:
Accurate dispensing depends on proper calibration.

  • Calibrate: If a pot shows "Uncalibrated", you must perform a calibration process (accessible via the Menu) to ensure accurate measurements.
  • Recalculate Regression: Advanced maintenance option to refine dispensing accuracy based on historical data.
  • Reset Errors: If a pot has encountered multiple dispensing errors, you can clear the error history via the Menu once the issue is resolved.

docs.title: 🧪 Manual Dispensing
docs.text:
The slider shows the current fill level in milliliters (ml).

Shows the current weight being dispensed in grams (g).

The final summary of the dispensing process.

You can manually dispense a specific amount of an ingredient for testing or custom use.

  1. Tap the main body of a bound pot card to open the Pot Details screen.
  2. Select or enter the desired amount in grams (g).
  3. Ensure a cup is placed under the dispenser.
  4. Tap Dispense.
  5. The screen will show the real-time weight being dispensed and a final summary of accuracy.
  6. Use the Stop button if you need to interrupt the process.

docs.title: Recipes and Dispensing Guide
docs.text: This guide explains how to use the Recipes and Dispensing features in the Mixer application.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: The Recipes feature allows you to browse available recipes, select specific versions or sizes, and start the automatic dispensing process.

docs.title: Recipe List
docs.text:
The main screen shows all available recipes.

List of all available recipes.

  • Categories: Use the tabs at the top to filter recipes by category.
  • Recipe Cards: Each recipe shows its name, a unique code, and its type.
  • Check Availability: Use the "Check Availability" button to see which recipes can be made with the ingredients currently loaded in the machine.

docs.title: Recipe Details
docs.text:
Selecting a recipe shows more information and options for preparation.

Recipe details and version selection screen.

docs.title: 1. Version Selection
docs.text: Many recipes have different variants or sizes. You can select the one you need, and the required ingredients and total weight will update automatically.

docs.title: 2. Ingredient Status
docs.text: The app will warn you if: - Any ingredients are missing. - There isn't enough of an ingredient left. - The machine's dispensers need calibration.

docs.title: 3. Ingredients List
docs.text: You can see all the ingredients required and the exact amount needed for the selected version.

docs.title: 4. Starting the Process
docs.text:
• Start Dispense: This begins the automatic mixing and dispensing process.
  • Mode Selection: Depending on the machine setup, you might be able to choose between a "Quick" or "Standard" dispensing mode.

docs.title: The Dispensing Process
docs.text:
While the machine is working, you can see real-time progress on the screen. The machine handles the precise measurement of each ingredient. If any issues occur, like a pump problem or an ingredient running out, the app will notify you immediately.

Real-time progress while the machine is dispensing.

docs.title: Results and Completion
docs.text:
Once the process is finished, a summary will appear: - Status: Confirms if the process was successful. - Weight Accuracy: Shows how much was actually dispensed compared to the target weight. - Automatic Logging: The machine automatically records the production data for your records.

Completion summary showing results and weight accuracy.

docs.title: Temperature Control
docs.text:
If a pot is equipped with a heater, you can control its temperature.

  1. Tap the Temperature icon on the pot card, or access it through the Pot Menu.
  2. Use the slider to set the desired temperature, typically between 10°C and 40°C.

  3. Tap Set to start heating.

  4. Monitor the Current Temperature in real time.

  5. Tap Stop at any time to turn off the heater.

docs.title: Mixer 用户指南
docs.text:
欢迎使用 Mixer 应用！

欢迎使用 Mixer 机器用户指南。本文档将帮助您设置并使用您的机器，每次都能调制出完美的饮品。

docs.title: 快速入门
docs.text:
• 主屏幕仪表板 - 中央控制面板概述。
  • 设置您的 Mixer - 关于如何首次准备机器的分步指南。
  • 容器管理 - 如何管理原料并监控容器状态。
  • 配方和出料 - 如何选择并制作您最喜欢的混合饮品。

docs.title: 支持
docs.text: 如需更多帮助，请联系我们的支持团队或访问我们的网站。

docs.title: 用户指南：主屏幕仪表板
docs.text: 主屏幕显示机器状态、近期活动和维护需求。

docs.title: 1. 机器信息
docs.text:
显示当前门店和机器信息。

  • 门店和机器信息：显示门店、设备型号、硬件版本和 PLC UUID。
  • 网络状态：WiFi 或互联网断开时显示警告。
  • 刷新：从服务器更新信息。

docs.title: 2. 硬件组件状态
docs.text:
显示关键硬件的状态和读数。

  • 秤：显示当前净重和在线状态。点击可校准或测试秤。
  • 电机：显示活动电机通道及连接状态。
  • 加热器：显示当前温度。
  • 扫描仪：显示扫描仪是否准备就绪。

docs.title: 3. 使用统计
docs.text:
汇总机器性能和维护需求。

  • 需要校准：显示需要校准的容器。
  • 今日订单：显示今天成功制作的配方。
  • 本周（失败）：显示本周失败的生产次数。
  • 本周（成功）：显示本周成功的生产次数。

docs.title: 4. 近期配方与活动
docs.text:
列出最近的生产记录。

  • 显示配方、目标体积、重量误差、订单 ID、状态和开始时间。
  • 点击配方可查看详情。

docs.title: 5. 低液位/空容器管理
docs.text:
显示液位较低或为空的原料容器。

  • 低原料：列出液位低于 1500 毫升或已空的容器。
  • 加料：点击原料打开加料界面。

提示：出现红色硬件警告时，先检查“硬件状态”面板。

docs.title: 设置您的 Mixer
docs.text: 本指南将帮助您完成 Mixer 机器的首次设置。设置向导旨在为使用机器做好准备，确保一切都经过校准并就绪。

docs.title: 概览
docs.text:
设置过程是一个简单的分步指南。开始时，机器将恢复到出厂状态： - 当前任何用户都将注销。 - 之前的设置将被清除。 - 所有原料容器将被重置。 - 配方列表将被刷新。

该指南包含几个简单的步骤。

docs.title: 1. 连接与识别
docs.text:
第一步是将您的机器连接到互联网并进行识别。

扫描机器背面或侧面的二维码。

  • Wi-Fi 连接：确保您的机器连接到可靠的 Wi-Fi 网络。
  • 扫描：使用应用扫描机器上的二维码。这有助于应用识别您的特定设备。
  • 注册：应用将自动在我们的服务中注册您的机器。
  • 检查组件：机器将对内部零件进行快速检查，例如扫描仪和泵。
  • 加载数据：您的机器将下载最新的配置和可用原料。

docs.title: 2. 秤校准
docs.text:
接下来，您将按照指引确保内置秤准确。

秤校准屏幕。

  • 准确性检查：此步骤确保秤能正确测量原料。
  • 归零：您将被要求确保秤在空载时读数为零。
  • 重量检查：您可能会被要求放置一个已知重量的物体以确认准确性。
  • 下一步：一旦秤准确，您就可以进行下一部分。

docs.title: 3. 泵校准
docs.text:
此步骤确保机器为每种原料出料准确的量。

测试每个泵的准确性。

  • 出料精度：测试每个泵以确保其输送正确数量的液体。
  • 验证：您将确认每个原料容器均已准备就绪并经过校准。
  • 准备就绪：确认后，您的机器正式设置完毕并可以开始使用！您将被带到主仪表板。

docs.title: 完成设置
docs.text:
完成泵校准后：

机器的主仪表板。

  1. 您的机器被标记为“就绪”。
  2. 您将被带到仪表板，在那里您可以开始制作配方！

docs.title: 机器测试清单
docs.text: 将机器送到门店前，完成以下清单。

docs.title: 容器
docs.text:
• 将原料绑定到容器，并确认容器显示原料名称。
  • 打开容器菜单，选择解绑容器，并确认原料已移除。
  • 校准每个容器，并确认校准完成。

docs.title: 机器组件
docs.text:
• 测试屏幕，并确认触摸有响应。
  • 测试网络连接。
  • 测试秤，并确认重量读数正确。
  • 测试扫描仪。
  • 测试声音。
  • 测试加热器（如已安装）。
  • 运行电机，并确认运行稳定。

docs.title: 配方和准确性
docs.text:
• 出料多个配方，并确认每个配方都成功完成。
  • 将每个配方的出料量与所需规格进行比较，并确认准确性。

docs.title: 补充原料
docs.text:
• 补充一个容器，并确认补充流程成功完成。
  • 确认机器已准备好发送到门店。

docs.title: 定制项
docs.text:
定制项是可附加到配方上的可复用选项，例如规格、糖度或温度。每个定制项都有编码、名称和一组值。本页介绍如何管理它们。

若要将定制项附加到具体配方，请参见 配方定制。

docs.title: 概览
docs.text:
定制项界面列出每个定制项的编码、名称、值和状态。

截图占位：定制项列表。

docs.title: 创建定制项
docs.text:
1. 点击新建。
  2. 输入编码、名称和值列表。
  3. 保存。

docs.title: 编辑定制项
docs.text:
1. 点击行上的编辑图标。
  2. 更新字段和值。
  3. 保存。

docs.title: 启用或停用定制项
docs.text: 使用行中的状态开关。

docs.title: 删除定制项
docs.text:
1. 点击行上的删除图标。
  2. 在对话框中确认。

docs.title: 原料
docs.text:
原料（物料）是配方使用的基础物品。本页介绍如何创建和管理它们，以及如何从 Excel 导入。

若要选择某个配方使用哪些原料，请参见 配方原料。

docs.title: 概览
docs.text:
原料界面列出你的原料，并可搜索、创建、编辑和删除它们。

截图占位：原料列表。

  • 搜索 —— 在搜索框中输入关键字以筛选原料。

docs.title: 创建原料
docs.text:
1. 点击新建。
  2. 填写原料信息。
  3. 保存。

docs.title: 编辑原料
docs.text:
1. 点击行上的编辑图标。
  2. 更新字段。
  3. 保存。

docs.title: 启用或停用原料
docs.text: 使用行中的状态开关。

docs.title: 删除原料
docs.text:
• 单个 —— 点击行上的删除图标并确认。
  • 批量 —— 用复选框选择原料，然后点击工具栏中的删除并确认。

docs.title: 从 Excel 导入原料
docs.text:
1. 点击上传。
  2. 选择 Excel 文件。
  3. 文件中的原料将被导入到列表中。

截图占位：从 Excel 文件导入原料。

docs.title: 机器
docs.text:
机器界面列出你可访问的机器，并可将其绑定到商店、设置密码，以及查看每台机器的配置和数据。

机器在工厂设置流程中注册。在经理后台中，你对机器进行配置和监控，但不在此处创建或删除机器。

docs.title: 概览
docs.text:
机器列表显示每台机器的 UUID、PLC UUID、型号、硬件版本、备注、所绑定的商店以及创建日期。

截图占位：机器列表。

docs.title: 将机器绑定到商店
docs.text:
• 如果机器未绑定，点击绑定到商店，选择商店并确认。
  • 如果机器已绑定，其商店名称显示为按钮；点击可更改商店。

docs.title: 解绑机器
docs.text:
1. 点击已绑定商店旁的解绑图标。
  2. 在对话框中确认。机器将从商店分离。

docs.title: 更改机器密码
docs.text:
1. 点击机器行中的密码图标。
  2. 输入并确认新密码。
  3. 保存。

docs.title: 通道
docs.text:
点击通道打开机器的通道配置，其中显示机器的料罐及绑定的原料。

截图占位：机器通道对话框。

docs.title: 机器详情
docs.text:
点击机器行可打开其详情页，包含：

  • 基本信息 —— 机器的主要信息。
  • 通道 —— 料罐及其绑定的原料。
  • 生产记录 —— 该机器生产的饮品及统计。参见 生产记录 和 统计。
  • 清洗 —— 机器的清洗数据。
  • 活动 —— 机器的活动日志。

截图占位：机器详情页。

docs.title: 经理文档
docs.text: Mixer 网页后台的经理区域用于管理产品（配方、原料和定制项）、组织商店与机器、监控生产以及管理用户账户。

docs.title: 概览
docs.text:
经理菜单分为两个部分：

产品管理

  • 配方 —— 创建和管理配方，从 Excel 导入/导出，并分发到商店。
  • 原料 —— 管理配方中使用的原料。
  • 定制项 —— 管理可附加到配方上的可复用选项（例如糖度或规格）。
  • 生产记录 —— 查看各机器生产的饮品。

设置

  • 商店 —— 将商店分组并为其分配配方。
  • 机器 —— 将机器绑定到商店、设置机器密码并查看机器数据。
  • 用户 —— 管理可登录后台的账户。

docs.title: 典型流程
docs.text:
经理常见的端到端流程如下：

  1. 创建所需的 原料 和 定制项。
  2. 创建 配方 并配置其原料、定制项和组合。
  3. 将配方 分发到商店。
  4. 组织 商店 并将 机器绑定 到商店。
  5. 监控 生产记录 和 统计。

截图占位：带侧边菜单的经理仪表板。

docs.title: 生产记录
docs.text: 生产记录界面列出各机器生产的饮品，便于你查看生产内容并排查问题。

docs.title: 概览
docs.text:
每条记录显示所生产的配方、订单信息以及结果。点击配方名称可快速按该配方筛选列表。

截图占位：生产记录列表。

docs.title: 筛选记录
docs.text:
使用列表顶部的筛选器缩小记录范围：

  • 关键字 —— 按配方搜索记录。
  • 订单 —— 按记录是否有订单筛选。
  • 状态 —— 按记录状态筛选。
  • 错误 —— 筛选以错误结束的记录。
  • 日期范围 —— 将记录限制在起止日期之间。

截图占位：订单、状态、错误和日期范围的筛选弹出框。

docs.title: 物料记录
docs.text:
打开某条记录的物料记录，查看该次生产所出料的原料及用量。

截图占位：某条生产记录的物料记录对话框。

docs.title: 单台机器的记录
docs.text: 单台机器的生产记录也可在机器详情页中查看。参见 机器。若需查看使用图表和总量，请参见 统计。

docs.title: 配方组合
docs.text: 组合定义了配方在其各个定制值组合下所使用的确切原料用量。本页是 配方配置 的一部分。

docs.title: 概览
docs.text:
当配方带有定制项时（例如规格：小/大 和 糖度：50%/100%），系统会为所选值的每一种可能组合生成一行。对于每种组合，你需要输入配方使用每种原料的用量。

截图占位：组合表，每种原料一列，每种定制组合一行。

docs.title: 前提条件
docs.text:
在配置组合之前，请确保配方已经：

  • 选择了 原料，并且
  • 选择了 定制项。

docs.title: 设置原料用量
docs.text:
1. 打开配方详情并进入组合部分。
  2. 对于每一行组合，在每个原料列中输入用量。
  3. 需要时，使用每种组合的其他选项为该组合设置附加值。
  4. 保存更改。

总计会根据你输入的用量自动计算，便于你一目了然地核对每种组合。

docs.title: 配方定制
docs.text:
配方可以提供诸如规格或糖度等定制选项。本页介绍如何将定制项附加到配方。它是 配方配置 的一部分。

定制项在 定制项 界面创建和管理。在此处你只需选择哪些已有定制值适用于该配方。

docs.title: 查看配方定制
docs.text:
打开某个配方的详情页。定制项部分按名称分组列出所有定制项，并显示该配方选中了哪些值。

截图占位：配方定制部分。

docs.title: 编辑配方定制
docs.text:
1. 点击定制项部分中的编辑图标。
  2. 勾选或取消勾选适用于该配方的定制值。使用全选可切换所有值。
  3. 点击保存。

所选的定制值决定了你在 配方组合 中配置的组合。

docs.title: 配方原料
docs.text:
每个配方都会使用一组原料（物料）。本页介绍如何选择配方使用哪些原料。它是 配方配置 的一部分。

原料本身在 原料 界面创建和管理。在此处你只需选择配方使用哪些已有原料。

docs.title: 查看配方原料
docs.text:
打开某个配方的详情页。物料部分列出配方使用的原料及其编码、名称、有效期和分组。

截图占位：配方原料（物料）部分。

docs.title: 编辑配方原料
docs.text:
1. 点击物料部分中的编辑图标。
  2. 使用原料选择器添加或移除原料。你可以按名称搜索原料。
  3. 点击保存。

更改原料后，你可以在 配方组合 中按选项设置其用量。

docs.title: 配方
docs.text: 配方界面用于创建和管理机器可生产的配方。你还可以在此将配方以 Excel 文件导入和导出，并将其分发到商店。

docs.title: 概览
docs.text:
配方列表显示每个配方的图片、编码、名称、外部编码、类别、创建日期、状态和备注。

截图占位：配方列表。

  • 搜索 —— 在搜索框中输入关键字以筛选配方。
  • 类别 —— 使用类别选择器按类别筛选。

docs.title: 创建配方
docs.text:
1. 点击新建。
  2. 填写基本信息。
  3. 保存。

创建配方后，你可以配置其 原料、定制项 和 组合。

docs.title: 编辑配方
docs.text:
1. 点击配方行上的编辑图标。
  2. 更新基本信息。
  3. 保存。

docs.title: 复制配方
docs.text: 点击配方行上的复制图标，根据所选配方预填充创建一个新配方。

docs.title: 启用或停用配方
docs.text: 使用配方行中的状态开关。

docs.title: 删除配方
docs.text:
• 单个 —— 点击配方行上的删除图标并确认。
  • 批量 —— 用复选框选择配方，然后点击工具栏中的删除并确认。

docs.title: 类别与配方分组
docs.text:
• 使用类别选择器按类别筛选列表。
  • 在选择器中点击类别旁的删除图标可删除该类别。
  • 在选择器底部选择新建可创建配方分组。

docs.title: 从 Excel 导入配方
docs.text:
1. 点击上传 Excel。
  2. 选择 Excel 文件。系统会显示将要导入配方的预览。
  3. 确认导入。

截图占位：Excel 导入预览对话框。

docs.title: 导出配方到 Excel
docs.text:
1. 用复选框选择一个或多个配方。
  2. 点击工具栏中的下载。所选配方将导出为 Excel 文件。

docs.title: 将配方分发到商店
docs.text:
1. 用复选框选择一个或多个配方。
  2. 点击工具栏中的分发。
  3. 在对话框中，选择分发到单个商店还是商店分组。
  4. 选择目标商店或分组并确认。

截图占位：包含商店与商店分组标签页的分发对话框。

你也可以在 商店 界面管理某个商店的配方。

docs.title: 配方配置
docs.text:
点击配方行可打开其详情页，在其中配置：

  • 基本信息 —— 配方的主要信息。
  • 定制项 —— 附加到配方的选项。
  • 原料 —— 配方使用的原料。
  • 组合 —— 每个定制组合的原料用量。
  • 历史 —— 配方的变更历史。

docs.title: 统计
docs.text: 统计将机器的生产记录转化为图表和总量，让你了解一段时间内的产量。

docs.title: 概览
docs.text:
统计按机器提供，位于机器详情页的生产记录部分。打开某台机器（参见 机器）并打开其统计视图。

截图占位：带图表的机器统计视图。

docs.title: 选择时间范围
docs.text:
统计默认显示今天。使用范围控件更改时间段：

  • 今天
  • 昨天
  • 最近 7 天
  • 自定义 —— 选择起止日期并应用。

docs.title: 查看图表
docs.text:
统计视图汇总所选范围内的生产情况，包括生产数量和错误总数。使用排除已取消开关可将已取消或已停止的生产从错误总数中剔除。

若需查看底层的逐条数据，请参见 生产记录。

docs.title: 商店
docs.text: 商店代表运行机器的实体门店。本页介绍如何将商店分组、创建和编辑商店、关联机器，以及管理分配给每个商店的配方。

docs.title: 概览
docs.text:
商店界面分为两个区域：

  • 商店分组（左侧）—— 用于组织商店的分组树。
  • 商店（右侧）—— 商店列表，可按所选分组筛选。

截图占位：左侧为分组树、右侧为商店列表的商店界面。

docs.title: 商店分组
docs.text:
使用左侧的分组树来筛选和组织商店。

  • 选择全部可列出所有商店，或选择某个分组仅列出该分组的商店。
  • 使用展开/收起按钮显示或隐藏分组面板。
  • 点击设置（齿轮）图标打开商店分组管理器，在其中创建、重命名和删除分组。

docs.title: 创建商店
docs.text:
1. （可选）在左侧选择一个分组，使新商店创建在该分组下。
  2. 点击新建。
  3. 填写商店信息（编码、名称、类型、分组、外部编码、标签、用户）。
  4. 保存。

docs.title: 编辑商店
docs.text:
1. 点击商店行上的编辑图标。
  2. 更新字段。
  3. 保存。

docs.title: 启用或停用商店
docs.text: 使用商店行中的状态开关来启用或停用商店。

docs.title: 删除商店
docs.text:
1. 点击商店行上的删除图标。
  2. 在对话框中确认。

docs.title: 将机器关联到商店
docs.text:
1. 点击商店行上的机器图标，打开商店机器对话框。
  2. 添加或移除属于该商店的机器。

你也可以在 机器 界面将机器绑定到商店。

docs.title: 商店配方
docs.text:
每个商店都有自己的一组已分配配方。

  • 点击商店行（或分组树中的分组）上的配方图标，打开商店配方对话框以查看或调整已分配的配方。
  • 点击同步配方图标以同步该商店的配方。

docs.title: 将配方导入分组
docs.text:
1. 在分组树中选择一个分组。
  2. 点击导入配方。
  3. 选择要导入到该分组各商店的配方。

若要从配方列表分发配方，请参见 将配方分发到商店。

docs.title: 商店详情
docs.text:
点击商店行可打开其详情页，其中显示：

  • 基本信息 —— 商店的主要信息。
  • 机器 —— 关联到该商店的机器。
  • 配方 —— 分配给该商店的配方。

截图占位：包含基本信息、机器和配方的商店详情页。

docs.title: 用户
docs.text: 用户界面用于管理可登录经理后台的账户。

docs.title: 概览
docs.text:
用户列表显示每个账户的用户名、全名、电话号码、状态和创建日期。

截图占位：用户列表。

docs.title: 创建用户
docs.text:
1. 点击新建。
  2. 输入用户名、全名、电话号码和密码。

docs.title: 编辑用户
docs.text:
1. 点击用户行上的编辑图标。

  2. 在对话框中确认。

docs.title: 将原料绑定到容器
docs.text:
1. 打开容器页面。
  2. 点击空容器，或尚未分配原料的容器。
  3. 从可用原料列表中选择原料。
  4. 确认容器上显示原料名称。

docs.title: 解除原料绑定
docs.text:
1. 打开容器页面。
  2. 点击容器旁边的菜单图标（三个竖点）。

  4. 确认操作。

docs.title: 清洗模块文档
docs.text: 本文档提供 Mixer 应用程序清洗模块的概述和用户指南。清洗模块确保饮料分配管道和容器（Pots）保持卫生状态。

docs.title: 概述
docs.text: 清洗模块允许用户对机器的分配通道（Pots）进行日常和深度清洗。它跟踪每个 Pot 的最后清洗时间，并提供引导式的多步骤深度清洗流程。

docs.title: 1. 清洗状态仪表板
docs.text: 主清洗屏幕显示所有 Pot 及其当前清洗状态： - Pot 信息： 显示 Pot 编号和分配的原料名称。 - 上次清洗时间戳： 显示 Pot 上次清洗的具体日期和时间。 - 状态指示器： - 绿色： 在过去 24 小时内清洗过。 - 橙色/警告： 超过 24 小时未清洗。 - 红色/危险： 从未清洗或需要立即处理。

docs.title: 2. 选择与批量清洗
docs.text: 用户可以选择单个 Pot 或使用“全选”功能同时对多个通道进行清洗。

docs.title: 3. 深度清洗流程
docs.text: 深度清洗是一个彻底的消毒过程，由三个主要阶段组成：

docs.title: 第 1 阶段：排空管道（冲洗）
docs.text:
• 目的： 使用温水冲洗掉管道中残留的液体。
  • 可调参数： 冲洗时间（0 到 20 秒）。
  • 说明： 在开始前向 Pot 中加入温水。

docs.title: 第 2 阶段：消毒（浸泡）
docs.text:
• 目的： 使用消毒剂浸泡管道内壁，确保彻底消毒。
  • 可调参数：
  • 冲洗时间： 初始消毒液流动的持续时间。
  • 浸泡时间： 消毒剂留在管道中的持续时间（最长 5 分钟）。
  • 循环： 此步骤可以重复多次以获得更好的效果。

docs.title: 第 3 阶段：最终冲洗
docs.text:
• 目的： 使用新鲜饮用水冲洗掉管道中残留的消毒剂。
  • 可调参数： 冲洗时间。

docs.title: 如何开始深度清洗
docs.text:
1. 从主导航栏导航到 清洗 (Cleaning) 选项卡。
  2. 选择 Pot： 点击您想要清洗的 Pot。您也可以使用“全选”。
  3. 点击 开始清洗。
  4. 第 0 步（排空管道）：
  5. 向选定的 Pot 中加入温水。
  6. 如有必要，调整冲洗时间。
  7. 点击 开始。
  8. 等待倒计时结束。
  9. 第 1 步（深度清洗/消毒）：
  10. 向选定的 Pot 中加入消毒液。
  11. 调整冲洗和浸泡时间。
  12. 点击 开始 [循环 X]。
  13. 一个循环结束后，您可以点击 开始 [循环 X+1] 重复，或点击 完成 进入最后阶段。
  14. 第 2 步（最终冲洗）：
  15. 向 Pot 中加入新鲜饮用水。
  16. 调整冲洗时间。
  17. 点击 开始。
  18. 完成： 所有步骤完成后，系统将更新所有选定 Pot 的“上次清洗”时间戳。

docs.title: 安全与维护提示
docs.text:
• 建议至少每 24 小时进行一次清洗，以保持饮料质量和卫生。
  • 始终确保为每个步骤准备好适当的清洁剂（温水、消毒剂、清水）。
  • 除非必要，请勿中断清洗过程。如果暂停，请记得恢复以确保循环完成。

docs.title: 清洗
docs.text:
1. 移除秤把手，并将大容器放在出料口下方。
  2. 将管道从容器上断开，并放入装有热水的大容器中。
  3. 打开容器页面。
  4. 点击底部的选择。
  5. 选择要清洗的容器。使用顶部标签导航器查看尚未清洗且需要清洗的容器。
  6. 点击清洗。
  7. 在排空管道步骤中选择时长或使用默认值，然后点击开始。
  8. 等待排空管道步骤完成。
  9. 确保出料口下方的容器为空。将装有管道的容器中的热水更换为热水和所需的清洗液。
  10. 选择出料时长和浸泡时长，然后点击开始。
  11. 浸泡步骤完成后，再重复一次或结束清洗流程。建议每天早上执行一次；每周深度清洗时重复多次。
  12. 在最后的排空管道步骤中，移走出料口下方的容器，并将热水容器中的水更换为热水。
  13. 选择时长，然后点击开始。
  14. 等待清洗流程完成。

docs.title: 使用二维码
docs.text:
1. 将杯子放在出料口下方。
  2. 扫描包含配方及其规格的二维码。
  3. 等待出料流程自动完成。
  4. 查看完成摘要。

docs.title: 使用配方页面
docs.text:
1. 打开配方。
  2. 选择配方。
  3. 选择所需规格。
  4. 将杯子放在出料口下方。

  5. 点击出料。

  6. 等待出料流程完成。

  7. 查看完成摘要。

docs.title: 填充和初始化容器
docs.text:
1. 用所需液体补充容器。
  2. 将大杯放在出料口下方。
  3. 打开容器页面。
  4. 点击容器上的菜单图标（三个竖点）。

  5. 选择补充。

  6. 将滑块调整到新的总容量。

  7. 点击加满。

docs.title: 补充多个容器
docs.text:
1. 用所需液体补充容器。
  2. 将大杯放在出料口下方。
  3. 打开容器页面。
  4. 点击底部的选择。

  5. 选择已补充的容器。

  6. 点击补充。

  7. 等待容器逐个初始化。

  8. 确认该流程。

docs.title: 入门指南
docs.text: 按照以下步骤准备容器并分配配方。

docs.title: 开始前
docs.text: 1. 确保机器已连接网络，并确认空秤显示为 0。

docs.title: 绑定原料
docs.text:
1. 打开容器页面。
  2. 点击未分配原料的容器。
  3. 从可用原料列表中选择原料。
  4. 确认容器上显示原料名称。

docs.title: 填充和初始化容器
docs.text:
1. 点击容器上的菜单图标（三个竖点）。
  2. 选择补充。
  3. 将滑块调整到新的总容量。
  4. 点击加满。
  5. 等待短暂的初始化完成（如开始初始化）。

docs.title: 出料
docs.text:
1. 打开配方。
  2. 选择配方。
  3. 选择所需规格。
  4. 检查原料是否可用，以及出料口是否已校准。
  5. 将杯子放在出料口下方。
  6. 点击出料。
  7. 等待出料流程完成。
  8. 查看完成摘要。

docs.title: 手动出料
docs.text:
您可以手动出料指定数量的原料。

  1. 打开容器页面。
  2. 点击要出料的容器。容器详情会在侧边栏中打开。
  3. 选择或输入所需的重量，单位为克（g）。
  4. 将杯子放在出料口下方。 )
  5. 点击出料。
  6. 查看实时出料重量和最终准确度摘要。
  7. 如需中断流程，点击停止。

docs.title: 容器管理 (Pots Management) 文档
docs.text: 容器管理 (Pots Management) 功能允许您监控和管理存储在机器各个容器（Pots）中的原料。每个容器都分配有一个编号，并可以关联到特定的原料、加热以及手动分配。

docs.title: 📋 容器概览
docs.text: 容器 (Pots) 屏幕显示所有可用的容器。每个容器卡片显示： - 容器编号 (Pot Number)：容器的唯一标识符。 - 原料名称 (Ingredient Name)：关联原料的名称（如果已分配）。 - 填充液位 (Fill Level)：当前体积，以毫升 (ml) 为单位。 - 温度 (Temperature)：当前温度和目标温度（如果加热已激活）。 - 状态徽章 (Status Badges)：校准状态指示器（例如“未校准”、“陈旧”）或过期提醒。

docs.title: 🔗 绑定与解绑原料
docs.text: 要使用容器，必须将其与系统材料列表中的某种原料“绑定”。

docs.title: 绑定容器
docs.text:
1. 点击一个空容器（或未分配原料的容器）。
  2. 将出现可用材料/原料列表。
  3. 选择您希望链接到此容器的原料。
  4. 容器现在将显示原料名称和默认的过期设置。

docs.title: 解绑容器
docs.text:
1. 点击容器卡片上的 菜单图标（三个垂直点）。
  2. 选择 解绑容器 (Unbind Pot)。
  3. 确认操作。这将清除原料分配并重置填充液位。

docs.title: 🌡️ 温度控制
docs.text:
如果容器配备了加热器，您可以控制其温度。

  1. 点击容器卡片上的 温度图标（或通过容器菜单访问）。
  2. 使用滑块设置所需温度（通常在 10°C 到 40°C 之间）。
  3. 点击 设置 (Set) 开始加热。
  4. 您可以实时监控“当前温度”。
  5. 随时点击 停止 (Stop) 关闭加热器。

docs.title: 💧 填充与清空容器
docs.text: 跟踪原料液位以确保机器可以完成配方。

docs.title: 填充（加满）
docs.text:
1. 点击 菜单图标 并选择 填充 (Refill)（或者如果填充液位极低，直接点击容器）。
  2. 调整滑块以反映容器中的新总重量/体积。
  3. 点击 加满 (Top Up) 保存更改。机器可能会执行简短的初始化。

docs.title: 清空
docs.text:
1. 点击 菜单图标 并选择 清空 (Clear)。
  2. 这将把容器的当前填充液位重置为 0ml，表示其已空。

docs.title: ⚖️ 校准与维护
docs.text:
准确的分配取决于正确的校准。

  • 校准 (Calibrate)：如果容器显示“未校准”，您必须执行校准流程（通过菜单访问）以确保测量准确。
  • 重新计算回归 (Recalculate Regression)：高级维护选项，根据历史数据细化分配精度。
  • 重置错误 (Reset Errors)：如果容器多次遇到分配错误，在问题解决后，您可以通过菜单清除错误历史记录。

docs.title: 🧪 手动分配
docs.text:
您可以手动分配特定量的原料用于测试或自定义用途。

  1. 点击已绑定容器卡片的主体部分，打开 容器详情 (Pot Details) 屏幕。
  2. 选择或输入所需的重量（以克 (g) 为单位）。
  3. 确保在出料口下方放置一个杯子。
  4. 点击 出料 (Dispense)。
  5. 屏幕将显示实时出料的重量以及最终的精度摘要。
  6. 如果需要中断过程，请使用 停止 (Stop) 按钮。

docs.title: 配方和出料指南
docs.text: 本指南说明了如何使用 Mixer 应用中的配方和出料功能。

docs.title: 概览
docs.text: 配方功能允许您浏览可用配方，选择特定版本或大小，并启动自动出料过程。

docs.title: 配方列表
docs.text:
主屏幕显示所有可用配方。

所有可用配方的列表。

  • 类别：使用顶部的选项卡按类别筛选配方。
  • 配方卡片：每个配方显示其名称、唯一代码和类型。
  • 检查可用性：使用“检查可用性”按钮查看哪些配方可以使用机器当前加载的原料制作。

docs.title: 配方详情
docs.text:
选择配方会显示更多信息和准备选项。

配方详情和版本选择界面。

docs.title: 1. 版本选择
docs.text: 许多配方有不同的变体或大小。您可以选择所需的版本，所需的原料和总重量将自动更新。

docs.title: 2. 原料状态
docs.text: 如果出现以下情况，应用将发出警告： - 缺少任何原料。 - 某种原料剩余不足。 - 机器的出料口需要校准。

docs.title: 3. 原料列表
docs.text: 您可以查看所需的所有原料以及所选版本所需的确切数量。

docs.title: 4. 启动过程
docs.text:
• 开始出料：这将开始自动混合和出料过程。
  • 模式选择：根据机器设置，您可以在“快速”或“标准”出料模式之间进行选择。

docs.title: 出料过程
docs.text:
在机器工作时，您可以在屏幕上看到实时进度。机器处理每种原料的精确测量。如果发生任何问题，例如泵故障或原料耗尽，应用将立即通知您。

机器正在出料时的实时进度。

docs.title: 结果和完成
docs.text:
过程完成后，将显示摘要： - 状态：确认过程是否成功。 - 重量精度：显示实际出料量与目标重量的对比。 - 自动记录：机器会自动记录生产数据以供您参考。

显示结果和重量精度的完成摘要。

docs.title: 温度控制
docs.text:
如果容器配有加热器，您可以控制其温度。

  1. 点击容器卡片上的温度图标，或通过容器菜单访问。
  2. 使用滑块设置所需温度，通常为 10°C 至 40°C。

  3. 点击设置开始加热。

  4. 实时查看当前温度。

  5. 随时点击停止关闭加热器。
